Feign death, revive, then kill by contact.

Feign death once.[nl]If no meeting starts before you return, activate Doom Awakening to move faster and attack the first non-impostor you touch.[nl]A meeting during feigned death kills you.[nl]Doom Awakening ends after one attack, when its timer runs out, or when a meeting starts.

Survive suspicion, then persuade the meeting to eject your rival.

Votes from other players build [color=#CC4D99]Ego[/color] if you survive the meeting.[nl]Once you have enough, publicly challenge another player. Get them ejected that meeting to win.[nl]Everyone can still vote for anyone or Skip. A failed challenge spends all your Ego.

[color=#CC4D99]Ego:[/color] Receive votes and survive to charge your challenge.[nl][color=#CC4D99]Win:[/color] Challenge someone, then get them ejected that meeting.[nl]Everyone can vote normally. Failure spends all your Ego.

Every power leaves something to steal.

Siphon a player to collect energy.[nl]If they use an ability while siphoned, you also collect its category and briefly disrupt their abilities in that category.[nl]Each player can give you energy once per round.[nl]Collect enough energy and different categories to reveal a Power Node.[nl]At the node, start Grid Breach and stay inside until the countdown ends to win alone.[nl]Leaving or a meeting interrupts the breach.

Siphon players for energy, once per player each round.[nl]An ability used during Siphon gives its category.[nl]It briefly disrupts that player's matching abilities.[nl]Collect enough energy and categories to reveal a Power Node.[nl]Start Grid Breach there and stay inside until the timer ends to win.[nl]Leaving or a meeting interrupts the breach.

Collect research samples, then submit your results.

[color=#E64D1A]Choose Adrenaline or Sedative[/color], then inject a player.[nl]Wait for the observation to finish and return to collect their sample before it expires.[nl]Each player counts once.[nl]Targets can cleanse the serum. Failed experiments can be retried.[nl]After collecting enough samples, use [color=#E64D1A]Submit Research[/color] and stay in place until it finishes.[nl]Everyone is warned.

[color=#E64D1A]Serum:[/color] Choose speed or slowdown, inject, wait, then collect a sample.[nl]Each player counts once. Cleansing cancels the attempt. You can try again.[nl][color=#E64D1A]Win:[/color] Collect enough samples, then submit while standing still.[nl]Everyone is warned. Stay alive until submission finishes.

Fool different players into reporting your fake bodies.

Place a fake body where someone might believe a kill happened.[nl]A report removes the fake and earns a point. [color=#FF8C00]The reporter stays alive[/color], and each player can only score for you once.[nl]Players can inspect a body up close. Finding a fake removes it without giving you a point.[nl]Reach the report goal while alive to win.

[color=#FF8C00]Prank:[/color] Leave one fake body. Reports score without killing anyone.[nl]Each reporter scores once. Inspecting a fake removes it without scoring.[nl][color=#FF8C00]Win:[/color] Reach your report goal while alive.

Set up a shadow zone and catch players inside it.

Place a [color=#A64DF2]shadow zone[/color]. Its boundary appears before it activates.[nl]While inside, you are hidden from other players and can kill targets in the same zone.[nl]Leaving the zone makes them safe from your attack.[nl]Place another zone after the cooldown. Reach your kill goal while alive to win.

[color=#A64DF2]Zone:[/color] Place a shadow zone. It activates after a short warning.[nl]Inside, you are hidden and can kill players in the same zone.[nl][color=#A64DF2]Win:[/color] Reach your kill goal while alive. Deploy again after the cooldown.[nl]Leaving stops your attack. Meetings and your death remove the zone.

Build pressure through kills and offer a public alliance.

Your first kill unlocks [color=#C71A29]Intimidate[/color]: a visible warning followed by a brief slowdown inside the marked area.[nl]Your next two kills increase its range.[nl]After four kills, offer one player an alliance.[nl]They can accept or reject it, and everyone keeps their normal vote.[nl]If they accept, you both win by surviving a later meeting.[nl]You can also win alone by being the last player alive.

[color=#E85C68]Intimidate:[/color] Your first kill unlocks a zone that warns, then slows players.[nl]Kills 2-3 widen it.[nl][color=#E85C68]Alliance:[/color] After 4 kills, offer a player an alliance. They can refuse.[nl][color=#E85C68]Win:[/color] Both allies survive a later meeting, or you are the last player alive.

Collect a body trace, then send a Wraith after a target.

Collect a [color=#9433E6]trace[/color] from a dead body, then choose who your Wraith hunts.[nl]The Wraith passes through walls, but the target is warned and can escape by surviving the hunt.[nl]You can send one Wraith at a time.[nl]A failed hunt returns your trace.[nl]A successful hunt uses it up.[nl]Meetings and your death end the hunt. Reach your Wraith kill goal while alive to win.

[color=#BD80FF]Hunt:[/color] Collect a body trace, choose a target, send one Wraith.[nl]It crosses walls. The warned target escapes by surviving the timer.[nl]Failure refunds the trace. Meetings and your death stop the hunt.[nl][color=#BD80FF]Win:[/color] Reach your Wraith kill goal while alive.

Follow your target, then catch them during a timed chase.

Stay near your assigned target to prepare the contract.[nl]Staying away too long reduces your progress.[nl]When it is ready, your target gets a warning and a head start before [color=#FFB14F]Cash Out[/color] unlocks.[nl]Catch them before the chase ends to win.[nl]Tracking gives brief updates rather than a constant location.[nl]A failed contract gives you another chance with a new target.

[color=#FFB14F]Prepare:[/color] Stay near your target. Long absences lose progress.[nl][color=#FFB14F]Chase:[/color] You are held still while your target gets a warning and head start.[nl]Then Cash Out unlocks. Tracking gives occasional updates.[nl][color=#FFB14F]Win:[/color] Catch them before time runs out. Failure assigns a new target.
